re_line: APEC Shenzhen opens · US tightens AI chip curbs · Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral looms · Russian jets near Taiwan/Japan/Korea
morning_memo: Commerce tightened export-control rules Nov 16 to close a loophole letting Chinese firms rent advanced AI chips remotely through third-country data centers, days before Trump departs for APEC in Shenzhen.

Xi Jinping met a wave of APEC leaders in Shenzhen, Canada's Carney, Peru's Fujimori, Mexico's Sheinbaum, Chile's Kast and Vietnam's To Lam, with China and Canada reviving a nine-year-dormant currency swap line and cutting tariffs further.
Taiwan, Japan and South Korea scrambled jets Tuesday after Russian military aircraft approached their airspace, hours before Putin arrives in China for Thursday's trilateral summit with Trump and Xi.

key_stat.label: Share collapse at a Chinese AI model-maker since the Nov 16 chip rule
key_stat.context: The slide tracked by Bloomberg followed Commerce's new curb on remote access to advanced AI chips and coincided with the Hang Seng Composite's *4.27 percent* same-day fall, its steepest move in the market data today.
key_stat.source: Bloomberg: China AI Highflier Crashes 85% as Chip Fears Hit Model Makers

prc_government.action: Confirms outcomes of China-Canada trade consultations
prc_government.document: 商务部新闻发言人就中加经贸磋商成果答记者问
prc_government.detail: MOFCOM's spokesperson addressed the results of trade talks with Canada the same day Xi met Prime Minister Mark Carney in Shenzhen, as the two sides expanded tariff relief.

prc_government.document: 关于2027年度符合申领汽车、摩托车、非公路用两轮摩托车和全地形车出口许可证条件企业名单的公示
prc_government.detail: MOFCOM issued a public notice listing companies eligible to apply for 2027 export licenses covering automobiles, motorcycles, off-road two-wheel motorcycles and all-terrain vehicles.

Changshu Bank has absorbed eight village and township banks so far this year, while Langfang Bank has severed all equity and debt ties with Huaxia Happiness, per Chinese financial media tracked under PBOC reporting.

prc_government.action: Shenzhou-24 spacecraft-rocket combination moved to launch zone
prc_government.detail: The Shenzhou-24 mission is to launch 'in the coming days' after the spacecraft-rocket combination was transferred to the launch zone, per the Nov 17 MND-linked release.

npc_politburo.action: Xi inspects Guangdong, urges implementation of Fifth Plenum spirit
npc_politburo.detail: Xi Jinping toured the Shenzhen-Zhongshan corridor's western artificial island and the Sun Yat-sen former residence in Zhongshan on Nov 16, urging officials to 'thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the 20th Central Committee's Fifth Plenum' and advance Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area integration.

calendar_watch.headline: APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting opens, Shenzhen
calendar_watch.detail: China hosts the 33rd APEC leaders' meeting Nov 18-19; a Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral is expected on the sidelines.

calendar_watch.headline: Taiwan nine-in-one local elections
calendar_watch.detail: 22 mayors and magistrates plus roughly 11,000 offices are contested, read as a mid-term test for President Lai Ching-te.

calendar_watch.headline: Nanjing Massacre National Memorial Day
calendar_watch.detail: 国家公祭日 commemorations typically draw MOFA and Japan-related rhetoric amid the current propaganda campaign tracked by the NYT.

calendar_watch.headline: G20 Leaders' Summit, Doral (Miami)
calendar_watch.detail: The US hosts Dec 14-15; Xi Jinping's attendance has not been confirmed.

overnight_items.headline: New images emerge of suspected intelligence asset linked to Nvidia's ex-CEO
overnight_items.body_text: CNN reported fresh images of a woman US intelligence has linked to the circumstances around Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia. The report deepens scrutiny of the espionage concerns feeding into the broader AI-chip policy fight ahead of Trump's China trip.

overnight_items.headline: Report ties Huang associate's husband to China-backed data-center empire
overnight_items.body_text: The WSJ reported that the husband of a woman linked to Jensen Huang built a data-center business backed by the Chinese state. The report adds a corporate-finance dimension to the espionage concerns already roiling Nvidia and US AI-chip policy.

overnight_items.headline: What to expect from US-China AI safety talks
overnight_items.body_text: AFP previewed expected US-China discussions on AI safety ahead of the Shenzhen summit, with details on scope still unconfirmed. The talks sit alongside unresolved export-control and cyber disputes left out of the May 2026 Beijing agreement.

overnight_items.headline: Trump takes less secure plane to China
overnight_items.body_text: The Washington Post reported Trump is flying to China on a less secure aircraft than his usual Air Force One configuration. The detail surfaced as Trump began his multi-stop Asia trip via Manila ahead of the Shenzhen summit.

overnight_items.headline: Trump to miss most of the ASEAN summit
overnight_items.body_text: Trump arrived in Manila as the ASEAN meeting was wrapping up, the NYT reported, underscoring how regional allies are balancing Washington and Beijing. The timing drew attention as Southeast Asian states weigh new US AI-chip restrictions against China ties.

overnight_items.headline: Nvidia scandal complicates run-up to Trump-Xi meeting
overnight_items.body_text: The Hill reported the unfolding Nvidia scandal is injecting friction into preparations for Trump's meeting with Xi in Shenzhen. The episode compounds an administration already split over AI chip-export policy toward China.

overnight_items.headline: US reshoring push still depends on Chinese factories
overnight_items.body_text: Bloomberg's feature on manufacturer Welly found that building a factory in America still requires importing Chinese equipment and expertise. The case illustrates the gap between reshoring rhetoric and current US industrial-supply dependence on China.

overnight_items.headline: APEC to focus on 'safe, responsible' AI use, China's ex-UN envoy says
overnight_items.body_text: A former Chinese UN envoy told Reuters that AI governance will be a central APEC theme this week. The remarks come as chip-access disputes between Washington and Beijing dominate the summit backdrop.

us_china.headline: AI espionage fears complicate Trump-Xi diplomacy
us_china.body_text: Espionage concerns tied to Jensen Huang's ouster at Nvidia are complicating AI diplomacy ahead of the Shenzhen summit, the NYT reported. Trump is separately backing a campaign to reinstate Huang despite allegations he had an affair with a Chinese intelligence-linked woman, the AP reported.

us_china.headline: Trump's advisers split over China policy ahead of summit
us_china.body_text: Treasury Secretary **Scott Bessent** has grown more hawkish on China amid AI-related economic-security concerns, clashing with Commerce Secretary **Howard Lutnick**, the WSJ reported. The rift surfaced as the administration finalized new AI-chip export curbs just before Trump's Beijing-adjacent APEC trip.

us_china.headline: Huang scandal seen raising congressional scrutiny of US-China ties
us_china.body_text: The scandal around Jensen Huang's Nvidia departure is becoming a larger variable in Congress's China posture, CNBC reported. Lawmakers are weighing national-security implications of his alleged ties to a Chinese intelligence-linked associate.

us_china.headline: US presses ICAO over Taiwan flight restrictions, China pushes back
us_china.body_text: Washington is pressing a UN aviation agency over Taiwan-related flight-designation restrictions, Reuters reported in an exclusive, drawing pushback from Beijing. The dispute adds a new friction point ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting in Shenzhen.

us_china.headline: US, allies coordinate to protect AI technology from China rivalry
us_china.body_text: The US and allied governments are coordinating to protect AI technology and infrastructure amid rivalry with China, Reuters reported, without detailing specific new joint measures. The effort follows Monday's Commerce rule tightening chip-access controls.

us_china.headline: Nvidia warns buyers of legal risk from China AI access
us_china.body_text: **Nvidia** warned chip buyers of legal risks tied to providing China with AI access, sources told CNBC. Commerce's new rule raises compliance exposure for resellers and data-center operators handling Chinese customers.

us_china.headline: China taps US AI models to train homegrown rivals, Reuters finds
us_china.body_text: Chinese AI developers are using US AI models to train homegrown rivals as chip-export curbs bite, Reuters reported in an exclusive investigation. The practice illustrates the limits of hardware-focused export controls on China's AI progress.

us_china.headline: China's $17 billion farm-purchase pledge falters ahead of summit
us_china.body_text: China's pledge to buy at least *$17 billion* a year in US farm goods is running behind pace ahead of the Trump-Xi summit, Bloomberg reported. The shortfall adds friction to the agricultural pillar of the May 2026 Beijing trade agreement.

china_world.headline: Taiwan elections enter home stretch as parties fight for heartlands
china_world.body_text: KMT leader Cheng Li-wun campaigned in Yuanlin as Taiwan's nine-in-one local elections near their Nov 28 vote, Nikkei reported. The contest is read as a mid-term test of President Lai Ching-te.

china_world.headline: Trump says he might meet North Korea's Kim in China
china_world.body_text: Trump said he could meet **Kim Jong Un** while in China, with the venue to be decided by Xi, Reuters reported. It would be their first meeting since 2019 if it occurs.

china_world.headline: China, Southeast Asia pledge to avoid disputes during Code of Conduct talks
china_world.body_text: China and ASEAN states pledged to avoid disputes during negotiations on a South China Sea Code of Conduct, the AP reported. Talks continued on the sidelines of this week's regional summitry in Manila and Shenzhen.

china_world.headline: Trump's AI-supremacy plan fuels resistance in the Philippines
china_world.body_text: The NYT reported pushback in Manila against Trump's AI-dominance agenda, as the Philippines weighs new US chip restrictions against its economic ties to China. The friction surfaced during Trump's Quad and ASEAN stops ahead of Shenzhen.

china_world.headline: Xi meets Vietnam's To Lam in Shenzhen
china_world.body_text: **Xi Jinping** met Vietnam's top leader To Lam in Shenzhen on the APEC sidelines, per a MOFCOM readout. No further details were released beyond confirmation of the meeting.

china_world.headline: PNG premier tells Xi it 'wasn't easy' to close Taiwan office
china_world.body_text: Papua New Guinea's prime minister told Xi that closing Taiwan's representative office in Port Moresby 'wasn't easy,' Reuters reported, confirming Taiwan no longer operates there. The remarks came during APEC-sideline talks in Shenzhen.

china_world.headline: Chinese envoy warns chip-equipment curbs threaten EU-China trade thaw
china_world.body_text: A Chinese envoy said new chip-equipment export curbs threaten the recent EU-China trade thaw, Reuters reported. The warning follows Monday's US rule tightening AI-chip access and parallel EU scrutiny of Chinese overcapacity.

china_world.headline: Xi meets Peru's Fujimori, Mexico's Sheinbaum, Chile's Kast at APEC
china_world.body_text: **Xi Jinping** told Peru's President Dina Boluarte Fujimori that China has been Peru's largest trading partner for *12 consecutive years* and that the upgraded China-Peru free trade agreement protocol took effect two weeks ago, citing the Chinese-built Chancay port as a boost to Asia-Latin America trade, per the MOFA readout. Xi separately met Mexico's Sheinbaum and Chile's Kast the same day in Shenzhen.

china_world.headline: Trump arrives in Manila for Quad talks ahead of China visit
china_world.body_text: Trump arrived in Manila for Quad and ASEAN talks before heading to Shenzhen for APEC and the trilateral summit with Xi and Putin, Reuters reported. The multi-stop itinerary reflects the administration's balancing act across Asia.

top_stories.headline: Commerce Tightens AI Chip Export Rules Ahead of Trump's China Trip
top_stories.body: The Commerce Department issued a rule Monday closing a loophole that let Chinese firms access advanced AI chips remotely through data centers in third countries, per the WSJ and CNN. CNBC reported the rule was drafted by Treasury and the National Security Council after criticism of Commerce Secretary **Howard Lutnick**, and the move triggered a chip-stock selloff hitting Samsung Electronics and TSMC, Reuters reported.

top_stories.headline: Russia Seeks 'Joint Statement' From Unprecedented Trilateral Summit
top_stories.body: Russia is seeking a joint statement from Thursday's trilateral meeting of **Donald Trump**, **Xi Jinping** and **Vladimir Putin** on the APEC sidelines in Shenzhen, the FT reported. The Kremlin said the meeting will have a 'major impact on global affairs,' per Reuters, as Trump departed Washington via Manila.

top_stories.headline: Beijing Runs Coordinated Propaganda Campaign Casting Japan as Aggressor
top_stories.body: Beijing is running a concerted campaign across state media and social platforms portraying Japan as a resurgent military threat, a NYT analysis found, following Prime Minister **Sanae Takaichi**'s Taiwan remarks. Takaichi held a brief first meeting with Chinese officials since the rift at APEC in Shenzhen, Bloomberg reported.

top_stories.headline: Taiwan, Japan, South Korea Scramble Jets Over Russian Aircraft Ahead of APEC
top_stories.body: Taiwan's defense ministry said it closely tracked two Russian warplanes flying along the island's eastern coast Tuesday, the same day Russian military aviation prompted fighter-jet scrambles in Japan and South Korea, per SCMP and BBC. The incursions came hours before **Vladimir Putin** arrives in China for Thursday's trilateral summit.

top_stories.headline: Taiwan Expected to Take Back Seat as Xi, Trump Meet a Third Time
top_stories.body: Taiwan's role is expected to recede when Xi and Trump meet for a third time at APEC, the AP reported. Taiwan's deputy foreign minister said approval timing on a *$14 billion* arms-sale package depends largely on Trump and will not be affected by the US midterm results, per Lianhe Zaobao, while Foreign Minister **Lin Chia-lung** makes his second US visit in two months, currently in Texas.

top_stories.headline: China, Canada Expand Tariff Relief, Revive Currency Swap as Xi Meets Carney
top_stories.body: China and Canada agreed further tariff reliefs and will revive a bilateral currency swap line after nine years, Bloomberg reported, as **Xi Jinping** met Prime Minister Mark Carney in Shenzhen. MOFCOM confirmed the trade-consultation outcomes the same day; the FT noted Ottawa's hedging against US pressure risks building dependency on Beijing.

also_today.headline: US companies from Nvidia to Apple face growing China dilemma
also_today.body_text: CNBC reported US firms face sharpening tradeoffs between China market access and tightening export rules.

also_today.headline: Jensen Huang's views on China chip market stretch back years
also_today.body_text: Bloomberg traced Huang's long-standing public positions on China AI chip access.

also_today.headline: Experts hope first China-US-Russia summit carries broader significance
also_today.body_text: Analysts told AP the unprecedented trilateral could shape dynamics beyond Asia-Pacific.

also_today.headline: Kremlin says Putin-Trump meeting in China is being prepared
also_today.body_text: Bloomberg reported Kremlin confirmation that logistics for a Putin-Trump encounter in China are underway.

also_today.headline: Taiwan ranks 13th of 70 economies in digital/AI competitiveness index
also_today.body_text: Taiwan's Ministry of Digital Affairs cited top-three global rankings in 13 indicators of the IMD survey.

also_today.headline: Five things to know about Xi's APEC diplomatic show in Shenzhen
also_today.body_text: Nikkei previewed the 33rd APEC forum, framing it as a showcase for Xi's diplomacy and Shenzhen's tech profile.

also_today.headline: Topco explores Idaho semiconductor, agricultural cooperation
also_today.body_text: Taiwan's Topco is planning a third US location and exploring semiconductor and agricultural ties with Idaho.

also_today.headline: K-pop idols pledge loyalty to Xi's Taiwan stance
also_today.body_text: Chosun reported entertainers publicly affirming alignment with Beijing's one-China position amid market-access pressure.

also_today.headline: Philippine FM says Taiwan was not discussed at ASEAN summit
also_today.body_text: VOA Chinese reported the Philippine foreign minister said Taiwan's role in South China Sea disputes was not raised at the ASEAN summit.

also_today.headline: UBS sees up to 15% upside for MSCI China on earnings, valuation
also_today.body_text: Bloomberg reported a UBS strategist's bullish call on Chinese equities despite today's broad selloff.

also_today.headline: China's buyback push struggles to put a floor under stocks
also_today.body_text: Bloomberg reported state-backed buyback support is failing to stabilize equities amid the chip-driven selloff.

business_economy.headline: China AI Highflier Crashes 85% as Chip Fears Hit Model Makers
business_economy.body_text: A Chinese AI model-maker's shares collapsed *85 percent* amid fears over chip access, Bloomberg reported, following Monday's US export-control tightening.

business_economy.headline: Samsung, TSMC Shares Fall After US Curbs on China's Chip Access
business_economy.body_text: Samsung Electronics and TSMC shares fell after the new US rule restricting China's AI-chip access, Reuters reported.

business_economy.headline: Clampdown on China Chip Loophole Puts Billions in Loans at Risk
business_economy.body_text: Banks financing data-center and chip-leasing deals face exposure as the new US rule closes the remote-access loophole, Bloomberg reported.

business_economy.headline: Foreign Funds Bought Most China Bonds Since May on Haven Appeal
business_economy.body_text: Foreign inflows into Chinese bonds hit their highest since May, Bloomberg reported, as haven demand rose amid the global chip-driven equity selloff.

business_economy.headline: EU Takes Aim at Knock-On Effects of Chinese Trade Overcapacity
business_economy.body_text: The EU is targeting secondary effects of Chinese industrial overcapacity on its own manufacturers, Bloomberg reported, amid parallel chip-equipment trade friction.

business_economy.headline: CATL Bets on Battery-Swapping to Cement EV Chain Dominance
business_economy.body_text: CATL is expanding battery-swapping infrastructure to reinforce its position across the EV supply chain, Bloomberg reported.

official_line.speaker: Guo Jiakun
official_line.statement: Per MOFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun: the new US chip export rule is a textbook case of 'economic coercion and long-arm jurisdiction'; the US government is abusing export control measures and undermining the stability of global production and supply chains, and China will resolutely safeguard its legitimate rights and interests.
official_line.original_zh: 典型的经济胁迫和"长臂管辖"；美方滥用出口管制措施，损害全球产供链稳定，中方将坚决维护自身正当权益
official_line.context: The statement responds to the Commerce Department's Nov 16 rule tightening restrictions on Chinese remote access to advanced AI chips.

official_line.speaker: Zhang Hanhui
official_line.topic: Fourth/Fifth Plenum significance for China-Russia ties
official_line.statement: Per Ambassador Zhang Hanhui's signed article in Rossiyskaya Gazeta: the Party's self-revolution is leading a magnificent new journey, outlining the contemporary value and world significance of the recent Central Committee plenary session.
official_line.original_zh: 以党的自我革命引领壮阔新程—中国共产党二十届五中全会的时代价值与世界意义
official_line.context: The signed article was published in the Russian state paper as Putin prepares to travel to China for the APEC-sideline trilateral summit.

official_line.speaker: MOFA spokesperson
official_line.statement: Per MOFA: China hopes to further build consensus with all parties and achieve more practical outcomes at this week's gathering.
official_line.original_zh: 中方期待同各方进一步凝聚共识，取得更多务实成果
official_line.context: The remark came at the Nov 17 regular press briefing as APEC leaders began arriving in Shenzhen.
